title: Area of the Limit Curve for Symmetric Nonstationary Corner-Cutting Schemes
summary: We consider corner-cutting schemes for closed oriented polygons in the plane. At each step every vertex is replaced by two points on the adjacent edges; the same cutting coefficient is used at all vertices of the current polygon, but this coefficient may vary from step to step. For such schemes we prove the existence of a continuous limit curve and derive an explicit formula for its oriented area.
